items.title: 53342_Cozy Cole oral history interview
items.q: to join Blanche Calloway's band... I'll tell you about Blanche Calloway's band... But we had a fairly nice band

ctx.x: Yes, yes, and I didn't stay with it too long because my first couple of days I had some nice clean overalls that I wore, and I came home that night and they were all full of that tar and everything, and I was saying God, there's got to be a much easier way to make a living than to fool with this. So anyway I didn't stay in that too long. Then from then on I was an errand boy, a shipping clerk, I was a porter, ran elevators around New York, things of that sort.
